scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'if docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -q vendorpulse-app; then echo "API already on :8000 (Docker vendorpulse-app-1). Rebuild: docker compose up -d --build app"; exit 0; fi; fuser -k 8000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; php artisan route:clear && php artisan config:clear && exec php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000'
scripts.dev:api:docker: docker compose up -d --build app && docker compose exec app php artisan route:clear && docker compose exec app php artisan config:clear
scripts.dev:mobile:web: npm run build:mobile:web && cd mobile_dashboard && php -S 127.0.0.1:7357 -t build/web
scripts.dev:frontdoor: concurrently -n next,flutter -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:mobile:web"
scripts.experience-monitoring:install: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.experience-monitoring:verify: node -e "require('playwright'); console.log('playwright module ok')" && npx playwright --version
